name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Technical Implementation Manager | Requirements to Go-Live, REST API Integrations, Data Migration & SQL
summary: Implementation manager who stays hands-on with the technical work instead of routing it to Engineering. Gathers requirements, configures workflows, builds and troubleshoots REST API integrations (JSON payloads, webhooks, error handling), runs data imports and cleanups with validation (including a 1,400+ contact CRM), and writes SQL and Python or JavaScript when a configuration needs it. Managed about 25 concurrent onboardings at peak at Wix while launching 25+ clients a month at 110% of implementation targets, and sold and scoped Accelo's professional-services automation platform (time tracking, utilization, project budgets) to services firms.

experience.title: Technical Implementation & Integrations (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Lead implementations from requirements through go-live: discovery, configuration of workflows and reporting, testing, client training, and post-launch support.
Build and troubleshoot integrations with REST APIs and webhooks in Zapier, Make, and n8n, reading request and response payloads (JSON) and fixing errors myself.
Write Python and JavaScript in custom code steps to transform data between systems, and run data imports into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, validating every record after load.
Query and model data with SQL (BigQuery, Power BI) and Excel to validate results and report on performance.
Document configurations, timelines, and decisions for every engagement in Notion and HubSpot.
